name: Left Behind: A DBD Fangame
source:
[i]"Left Behind"[/i] is a Visual Novel fangame of popular asymmetrical horror game [i]Dead by Daylight[/i] that depicts a standard Trial. The player follows 1 of 5 characters through a tense match of cat and mouse between 4 survivors and one Killer. The Goal? To not be Left Behind and survive to see another day.

[From [url=https://fearplays.itch.io/left-behind]Itch.io[/url]]
